mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM `transaction` t WHERE ORDER BY t.biz_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.biz_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS expense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END), 0) AS balance, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `transaction` t WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.biz_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `transaction` SET type = #{t.type}, amount = #{t.amount}, category_id = #{t.categoryId}, category_name_snapshot = #{t.categoryNameSnapshot}, sub_category_id = #{t.subCategoryId}, sub_category_name_snapshot = #{t.subCategoryNameSnapshot}, account_id = #{t.accountId}, account_name_snapshot = #{t.accountNameSnapshot}, biz_date = #{t.bizDate}, remark = #{t.remark} WHERE id = #{t.id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT t.category_id AS categoryId, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.category_id

SELECT t.created_by AS createdBy, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.created_by

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS expense, COUNT(*) AS count, MIN(t.biz_date) AS minBizDate

SELECT t.category_id AS categoryId, t.sub_category_id AS subCategoryId, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.category_id, t.sub_category_id ORDER BY t.category_id ASC, amount DESC, t.sub_category_id ASC

SELECT t.account_id AS accountId, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.account_id ORDER BY amount DESC, t.account_id ASC

SELECT t.biz_date AS bizDate, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.biz_date ORDER BY t.biz_date ASC

SELECT t.created_by AS createdBy, t.category_id AS categoryId, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY t.created_by, t.category_id
